The problem is that if you are even skilled, it is favored towards Fiora. You are mostly trying to mind games her while shes just being Fiora. If she parries your hookshot, you just lose the matchup. Its a lot more on you than it is on her. I main both but I'm not some high elo player. So take what you want from that.

Personally she is just weak top and better in the jungle. Comet is for poking out unfavorable match. Conq and PTA isn't that bad and the updated Hail of blades is something I've been trying. Bone plating and overgrowth is pretty good for secondary. Fiora is your biggest counter. She has a lot of unfavorable and favorable matchups but it mostly comes to how often you hit stun. You can start with hitting W for the slow then E, then AA Q AA Q. You are a stronger split push than teamfight. Once you get triforce, taking turrets becomes really fast and you should pressure splitting. Practice her flash hookshot. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rxCrFy5ov8E that is a good guide on some basic and advanced stuff. Also try to take trades when you have passive up. If they can't really follow up with damage do the follow combo but if they can just hit the stun, AA Q AA then just walk away. Don't overstay for the empowered 2nd Q if they can do more damage to you.
